svg.title: Remove and re-append a node in a doubly linked list with sentinels
svg.desc: H and T are sentinels. After remove(B), A and C point at each other and B is detached with stale pointers. append(B) puts B between C and T.
svg.text: remove(B): A.next B → C, C.prev B → A
B.prev = C, B.next = T, C.next = B, T.prev = B
